summary.text: Dick Dever is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 32 (Bismarck) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Dick Dever's service as "Senate since 2001". The member page lists Dick Dever's committee assignments as including the Budget Section - Human Resources Division (Chairman), the Human Services Committee and the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Dick Dever's occupation as Retired.
It lists military service as US Army.

It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Board, Burleigh County Human Service Zone; Board, PERS; BILLD Fellow; Life Member, Judge Advocate, VFW Post 1326; Life Member, Commander, AmVets Post 9; Bis-Man Chamber; GNDC Chamber Champion; Behavioral Health Champion (2019); Elder, Shepherd of the Valley Lutheran Church.
Dick Dever is listed as married to Pam with 3 children and 12 grandchildren.
